app_key_command.description: Command that prints the application key.

app_key_env.description: Environment variable holding the application key. Default DD_APP_KEY.

base_url.description: API address, if not https://api.<site> (a proxy, for example).

name.description: Only monitors whose name contains this text.

show_ok.description: List monitors that are OK too. Default false.

site.description: Your Datadog site: datadoghq.com (default), us3.datadoghq.com, us5.datadoghq.com, datadoghq.eu, ap1.datadoghq.com.

tags.description: Only monitors with all of these monitor tags, e.g. team:web.

token_command.description: Command that prints the API key, e.g. [op, read, op://ops/datadog/api-key].

token_env.description: Environment variable holding the API key. Default DD_API_KEY.

entries.description: Datadog monitors: how many are alerting, warning or without data, and a list of the ones that need a look, each linking to the monitor. Filter by monitor tags or name. Built from Datadog's public API docs (GET /api/v1/monitor) and untested live.
entries.name: Datadog monitors
